| [NOTE-059](../../../record/notes.d/NOTE-059.md) v2 | Peters & Adamou 2022, the ergodicity solution of cooperation | If N entities' resources follow GBM (drift μ, volatility σ, independent noise), then pooling and sharing equally every step leaves the drift at μ, cuts the volatility to σ/√N (Eq. 3.9), and raises each member's time-average growth rate from μ − σ²/2 to μ − σ²/(2N) (Eq. 4.1).
